definitions.C: explicit local coexistence of discrete natural floral-colour variants in the same population/site
definitions.S: explicit spatial segregation/structuring of discrete floral-colour variants or morph frequencies among geographic units
definitions.zero_semantics: not documented by the strict pass; not biological absence
definitions.mixed_semantics: C and S both documented; local coexistence and broader spatial structuring can coexist at different scales

notes: The historical 34-species binary freeze remains intact as a provenance/sensitivity dataset.
Sexual-organ-only colour polymorphism (androecium/anther/pollen colour) is excluded from the floral-display freeze.
C and S are independent positive-evidence axes; absence of a positive match is not interpreted as biological absence.
